title: Plain-Text Accounting Verifier
description: Parses a plain-text-accounting journal (hledger/Beancount-style, synthetic) locally, validates double-entry balance and any inline balance assertions, computes an RFC 6962 Merkle root over the parsed transactions, and emits an AINumbers Evidence Envelope v0.1 receipt. Mirrors the art-653 verification kernel. Zero network calls.

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_plain_text_accounting_journal
mcp_tool_definition.description: Parses a plain-text-accounting (hledger/Beancount-style) journal, validates double-entry balance and inline balance assertions, computes an RFC 6962 Merkle root over transactions, and returns an AINumbers Evidence Envelope v0.1 receipt with execution_hash. Use when an agent needs to independently verify a synthetic accounting journal's arithmetic integrity.
